kai-master-builder 1.0.0

- Initial release of kai-master-builder.
- Generates secure, structured project plans and detailed task lists for building apps or features.
- Guides users (or runs autonomously) through an iterative build/test/report/document loop.
- Supports automated execution via cron or user-driven prompts.
- Encourages strong security practices and clear validation for every task.
- Tracks progress and handles blocked tasks for efficient project management.
